entities.name: Israelit Hospital of Tunis
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jewish Hospital of Tunis was a former Tunisian hospital founded for the Tunisian Jewish community. It was founded by Jewish doctors from Livorno. It opened in 1895 at Place Halfaouine, a suburb north of the Medina of Tunis.
